name: Current Australian MND statistics
publisher: Australian Institute of Health and Welfare
description: AIHW national statistics on MND prevalence, deaths, hospitalisations, burden of disease, expenditure, NDIS plan counts, aged care data and limitations of different data sources.
care_team_notes: Use AIHW for current Australian numbers. Explain whether a number is prevalence, mortality, hospitalisation, NDIS plan count or modelled burden rather than mixing them together.

name: MND Australia research statistics
description: MND Australia statistics and mortality tables, including recent Australian prevalence estimates and references to Every Moment Matters.
care_team_notes: Use alongside AIHW and preserve dates. If numbers differ, explain the data source and method rather than treating them as contradictions.

name: Risk factors and possible causes of MND
description: Australian MND information on possible causes and theories, including genetics, environmental toxins/chemicals, viral infection, immune-related damage and ageing, with caution that association is not the same as cause.
care_team_notes: For 'why did I get MND?' questions, answer gently: the cause is usually unknown, risk factors are not personal blame, and individual causation cannot be determined from population studies.

name: MiNDAus Registry
description: Australian MND Registry information: voluntary, secure registry open to Australians diagnosed with MND, collecting clinical and optional data to improve care, services and research.
care_team_notes: Make clear the registry is voluntary and separate from clinical care. Direct practical joining questions back to the registry/MND clinic source.

name: National MND data strategy
description: MND Australia position on using MiNDAus as part of a broader national data strategy to consolidate fragmented data, improve services and accelerate research.
care_team_notes: Use for policy/advocacy context, not as proof that a comprehensive national system already exists.

name: Every Moment Matters economic and human impact report
description: Report page covering the human and economic toll of MND in Australia and recommendations on funding pathways, data strategy, national directory, support program and terminal illness definitions.
care_team_notes: Use for system-level impact, policy and advocacy questions; direct individual funding questions back to NDIS/My Aged Care/Services Australia topics.

name: NSW MND notification from 1 September 2026
description: NSW Health announcement dated 31 August 2026 that NSW will make MND a notifiable condition from 1 September 2026, requiring medical practitioners to notify NSW Health of MND cases.
care_team_notes: Use exact dates. This is NSW-specific and starts on 1 September 2026; do not describe it as national notification unless a national source later confirms that.

name: Data source limitations
description: Notes on limitations in Australian MND data, including prevalence estimation limitations, GBD modelling limitations, ED coding limitations and why registry participation matters.
care_team_notes: When asked for exact numbers, explain uncertainty and source limitations. Avoid over-precision when the source says data are incomplete or modelled.
